messages:
Maria: Heads-up — quick follow-up from last night's auth-provider outage. Postmortem will cover root cause, but we need immediate remediation owners for recurring patterns (auth flakiness, model-registry fallbacks, vendor escalation).
Jon: Thanks — can we list owners now? I want to avoid action drift.
Sasha: I can own the runbook updates + token fallback flow. Will open a PR with steps and playbook by EOD Thu.
Lee: I'll own vendor escalation and SLA tracking. Will submit the escalation template to cloud-auth and loop in legal by Mon.
Tanvi: We should also design a model-registry read-only fallback (pin + local cache) for short auth blips — Eng-ML to own design/QA.
Jon: Eng-ML ok to take that. I'll prototype a pinned-cache path (no write) and a health-check gate. Target: 2-week spike.
Maria: Ops — can we run a chaos drill simulating auth latency+token TTL expiry next week? Dry-run preferred first.
incident-bot: Incident bot: created ticket INC-4721, added checklist and owners (Sasha, Lee, Jon, Tanvi). Assigned priority: P2.
Sasha: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pulls/234 — added sequence for token fallback, KV cache invalidation caveats, and a couple of curl examples:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $FALLBACK_TOKEN" https://model-registry.redwood/api/v1/models
```
Lee: Escalation sent to cloud-auth@vendor.com + account manager CC'd. Requested 72h response & postmortem commitment. Ticket ref: VEND-9982.
Tanvi: For model-registry fallback: plan = pinned model manifest + local artifact cache on dedicated nodes; need infra capacity estimate.
Jon: Infra calc preliminary: ~200GB storage, 4 vCPUs for cache nodes, ephemeral autoscale. I'll run full cost estimate and post to INC-4721 by Fri.
Maria: Quick action checklist (owners + target dates):
- Sasha: Runbook + PR by Thu 04/10
- Lee: Vendor escalation sent + SLA follow-up by Mon 04/07
- Jon: Pinned-cache prototype + infra ask by 04/21
- Tanvi: Final design + QA plan by 04/15
- Ops: Chaos dry-run Wed 04/09 (confirm scope)
Lee: Added owner tags and timeline in INC-4721. I also noted legal and support contacts.
Jon: I'll schedule a 20-min sync next Tue to unblock infra decisions and follow-ups. Weekly check-ins for 3 weeks after that.
Maria: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Please update INC-4721 as each item progresses. Closing thread here so we don't duplicate updates in multiple channels — reply in ticket if needed. :white_check_mark:
